---SELECT
select CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode 
,dateadd(dd,-1,LEAD(PeriodStartDate, 1 ,'2100-01-01') OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode ORDER BY PeriodStartDate)) as end_date
from bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
where  SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 
AND PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31' 
AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date' 
AND CustomerAccountId = '0007a2f18518a7d4b2e99238849328d0'

dateadd(dd,-1,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodEndDate)))

---UPDATE
select A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodStartDate,B.end_date,A.PeriodBalanceTypeId,A.FinancialInstitutionId,A.SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A 
LEFT JOIN (select CustomerAccountId
            ,PeriodBalanceTypeId
            ,PeriodStartDate
            ,FinancialInstitutionId
            ,SourceSystemCode 
            ,dateadd(dd,-1,LEAD(PeriodStartDate, 1 ,'2100-01-01') OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode ORDER BY PeriodStartDate)) as end_date
            from bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
            where  SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 
            AND PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31' 
            AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date'
            AND CustomerAccountId IN( 'paste_here','paste_here'  )) B ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = B.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.PeriodStartDate = B.PeriodStartDate
WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 
AND A.PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31' 
AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date' 
and A.CustomerAccountId IN ( 'paste_here','paste_here' )


---UPDATE
UPDATE A
SET PeriodEndDate = B.end_date
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A 
LEFT JOIN (select CustomerAccountId
            ,PeriodBalanceTypeId
            ,PeriodStartDate
            ,FinancialInstitutionId
            ,SourceSystemCode 
            ,dateadd(dd,-1,LEAD(PeriodStartDate, 1 ,'2100-01-01') OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode ORDER BY PeriodStartDate)) as end_date
            from bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
            where  SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 
            AND PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31' 
            AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date'
            ) B ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = B.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.PeriodStartDate = B.PeriodStartDate
WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 
AND A.PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31' 
AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date' 





SELECT top 100
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerAccountId,PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate,PeriodEndDate,BalanceAmount,IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId)) HASHROW
    , CustomerAccountId
    , FinancialInstitutionId
    , PeriodBalanceTypeId
    , PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance  
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --AND PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31'
AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date'
order by  CustomerAccountId,PeriodStartDate desc
